title: Brazilian Portuguese - Religion & Philosophy Subject Matter Expert (SME)
description: Project Overview Help shape the future of AI in Brazil! We are building a next‑generation benchmark to evaluate how well AI systems handle complex, real‑world questions in Brazilian Portuguese. This project will help improve how AI delivers accurate, reliable, and context‑aware responses for the Brazilian market. We are seeking Brazilian Portuguese Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in Religion & Philosophy to create high‑quality, expert‑level question‑and‑answer content. This role goes beyond basic data labeling and requires deep domain knowledge, critical thinking, and strong writing skills to test advanced reasoning and contextual understanding in Brazilian Portuguese. Suitable backgrounds may include theology and religious studies; senior clergy with teaching or publishing experience; anthropology or cultural history of religion in Brazil, and senior practitioners affiliated with religious or cultural institutions. For philosophy‑focused profiles, relevant experience may include professional philosophy, ethics (including applied ethics); political or social philosophy; senior‑level philosophy education, or recognized authorship or public intellectual work. Please submit your resume/CV in English.
min_qualifications: Native or fluent proficiency in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR) 5–10+ years of professional experience in a relevant field Demonstrated expertise through academic background and/or industry experience Strong analytical skills and the ability to explain complex concepts in a clear, structured manner Excellent written communication skills and attention to detail Ability to work independently and deliver high-quality output in a guideline-driven environment Nice to Have Experience with content creation, research, education, or knowledge evaluation Familiarity with AI training, data annotation, or evaluation projects Background in interdisciplinary work (e.g. history, anthropology, law and ethics, political theory, cultural studies) #LI-CAN17
